comments: Input facts: ego is a car responder; agent1 is a car initiator; interaction begins in different same-direction lanes in the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: Agent1 starts abreast in the right lane and initiates a left lane change; ego brakes in response to nearby lateral intrusion. Initial longitudinal distance or offset is (-1, 1) m; ego target speed is (10, 12) m/s; agent1 target speed is (10, 12) m/s. Agent1 follows for 1 s before initiating its lane change when the target lane has no object within a sampled 1–2 m clearance threshold. Ego response threshold is 7–9 m for the leading incursion or 3.6–4.2 m for the abreast incursion; brake input is 0.65–0.9. Outcome intent: a conflict opportunity; collision is not required. No fixed simulation horizon is specified. Ego enables its explicit response after 2 s, one second after agent1 becomes eligible to initiate the incursion; it then responds when its proximity trigger is met.
